item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 23/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, an anticyclone aloft will bring generally fine weather to the region. The broad area of low pressure now near the Philippines will move towards the central part of the South China Sea, and develop gradually in the next few days. However, its intensity and movement remain uncertain. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. There will be a few showers over the region.
